## What changed

Describe the problem, the chosen approach, and any user-visible behavior.

## Evidence

List the tests, screenshots, fixtures, or source documentation used to verify the change. Do not include credentials, private data, account details, positions, internal addresses, or workstation paths.

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] Numbers shown to users come from tool or test evidence rather than model invention.
- [ ] Time, cost, benchmark, and execution semantics remain explicit.
- [ ] New failure modes fail closed where evidence or authorization is missing.
- [ ] No real-order or account-credential path was introduced.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior, and relevant Python/web quality gates pass.
- [ ] Documentation and the public release allowlist are updated when needed.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, private assets, generated databases, caches, or machine-specific paths.
